io.model: Circular display approximation, not date-specific ephemeris; no original measurement uncertainty supplied by table.

s2_teaching.nature: Rounded teaching reconstruction consistent with period~16 yr and periapsis~120 AU. Angle and distance are not quoted fitted parameters. No downloaded astrometric time series, no fitting or GR precession.

uncertainty_note: All slider errors are user-chosen hypothetical 1 sigma independent small errors. They are not uncertainties quoted by observations. Correlations, G uncertainty and model systematics omitted.
shadow_and_photometry: Teaching inputs, not measurements extracted from the displayed Tycho or distance-ladder images.
